input: Crew expertise and shift-minute capacities plus work orders with estimated durations
bottleneck: Meaning-aware many-job routing without crew overload
ai: Real MiniLM embeddings of job descriptions and expertise
deterministic: Greedy semantic assignment with indivisible jobs, threshold and remaining minute capacity
